description: REEDR is the Residential Energy Efficiency and Demand Response tool developed by Ptarmigan Consulting. It builds and runs residential EnergyPlus models from spreadsheet inputs for geometry, envelope construction, glazing, infiltration and schedules. A graphical interface selects the input workbook, simulation period, output detail and end uses, with an option for concurrent runs. Outputs retain individual EnergyPlus results and an aggregated run report with unit and label conversions. Coverage is a user-defined residential scenario, with annual, sub-annual or one-day test periods and annual, hourly or simulation-timestep outputs. Public Python source is free under GPL-3.0-or-later. The documented implementation is limited to Windows and EnergyPlus 22.2.0. Another practical caveat is that the workbook must be saved before execution because the tool reads the saved file, not live spreadsheet changes. REEDR supports residential retrofit and demand-response scenario comparisons. It uses the catalogue's EnergyPlus model (model-energyplus); inputs and building assumptions still require checking, and no run was performed during this metadata review.
